name: io.github.telegraphprotocol/telegraph
description: Ranked machine intelligence for any agent: ask Telegraph's top miners, browse intents and rankings. Paid automatically from a USDC escrow; run `setup` once.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAPH_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: a 0x key instead of the wallet that `setup` saves to ~/.telegraph. Without either, only the free tools work.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAPH_URL
environmentVariables.description: Telegraph node URL. Default: beta 2, https://devnode.telegraphprotocol.com

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAPH_PAYMENT
environmentVariables.description: escrow (default), auto (escrow, then x402) or x402.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAPH_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Chain RPC for the balance and deposit tools. Default: a public Sepolia RPC.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAPH_MAX_ASK_USD
environmentVariables.description: Most one ask may cost. Default 0.5.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAPH_DAILY_LIMIT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Most all asks may cost in a UTC day. Default 5.
